intent.goal: Produce a bounded status artifact for the P0 spike.

tasks.author_prompt: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. It must be valid JSON with exactly these keys: task, status, checks. Set task to low-status, status to complete, and checks to a non-empty array of short ASCII strings describing deterministic checks.

intent.goal: Produce a mediated-boundary artifact for the P0 spike.

tasks.author_prompt: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. It must be valid JSON with exactly these keys: task, mediation, controls. Set task to medium-boundary, mediation to required, and controls to an array of at least two short ASCII strings about bounded execution controls.

intent.goal: Produce an approval-bound artifact that is resumed from durable evidence.

tasks.author_prompt: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. It must be valid JSON with exactly these keys: task, approval, evidence. Set task to medium-resume, approval to required, and evidence to an array of at least two short ASCII strings about durable resume evidence.
